verdict.rationale: Brex documents both physical and virtual corporate cards (brex-docs-20). Virtual cards can be created instantly or in one click (brex-docs-14, brex-docs-38), and the developer docs cover bulk-issuing virtual cards to employees and setting per-user monthly limits (brex-docs-30, brex-docs-32), with spend limits managed through the Budgets API and limit controls (brex-docs-5, brex-docs-9). A community comment praising the dynamic card generator corroborates virtual-card issuance (brex-comm-1). Missing for 10: evidence that physical cards are issued to team members within minutes, explicit documentation of a per-card (rather than per-user or budget) limit setting in the dashboard flow, and hands-on corroboration of issuance speed.
